        Back up your books

        Download everything as one file to keep somewhere safe, or to move your books to another browser, computer or the Semi Colon website.

        Books inside this file

        Use it with no internet

        Download Semi Colon as one file. Open it in Chrome, Edge or Safari and it works with no internet at all, even if this website ever goes away. Books written in the file stay with the file, so use Download a backup and Restore from a backup to move them between the file and the website.

        Export

        History

        Every time this page is saved, the copy before it is kept on this computer, so a slip of the keyboard or a bad paste can be undone. Restoring one keeps the current text here too.

        Deleted books and notebook pages are in Trash, on your shelf.
